predecessors.name: Mali
predecessors.text: the Malian regions of Timbuktu, Kidal and Gao, 'as well as a part of Mopti Region', 'about 60 percent of Mali's total land area'

successors.name: Mali
successors.text: the north, 'partially recaptured' by Malian and French forces from February 2013

ledger.x: 6 April 2012: the MNLA declares the independence of Azawad.
14 February 2013: the MNLA renounces its independence claim.

wars.name: Azawad rebellion and Operation Serval
wars.outcome: The MNLA declared Azawad independent on 6 April 2012 and lost its towns to Islamist groups by 12 July 2012; French forces intervened on 11 January 2013 and with Malian forces 'partially recaptured the north' a month later; the MNLA renounced independence on…

certainty.note: The extent of the land held is the MNLA's claim, 'about 60 percent' of Mali; the page gives no front lines, and control passed to Islamist groups within three months.
